column1: # Measured tests of the split packages of ci/go_test_splits.tsv (CHAOS-13668): package<TAB>TestName<TAB>seconds. A go-quality test
# leg cuts a split package's names into its parts by these rows (ci/go_race_shard.awk cut()): a measured name longest first onto the
# lightest part, any other name by a hash of its own name, so adding or removing an unmeasured test moves no other test. The plan
# weighs a part by its rows plus an even share of what the rows leave of the package row in ci/go_test_weights.tsv.
# seconds = round(W * median over runs of e/E): e = the test's top-level elapsed, E = the summed top-level elapsed of the package's
# tests in that run, W = the package row of ci/go_test_weights.tsv. Source: the go-test-timings-test-K artifacts (go-quality.yml) of
# 4 successful go-quality push runs on main at 10 test legs (43376042584, 43377857475, 43379257796, 43443132054), median over 4.
# Rows: every listed test of 2 s or more, and each package's heaviest tests up to its part count (no part can be empty).
# A row must name a test `go test -list` reports: renaming or removing a measured test needs its row edited in the same change
# (the leg and internal/cigates/testshard fail otherwise). Refresh: the same reduction over newer runs; values only cost balance.
